title: Push-forward of an integer multiplicity representation by η_{x,λ}
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), x ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0, η = η_{x,λ}, and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity representation (IMRep) of T in U. Then there is an IMRep R' of η_{x,λ#}T in η(U) such that μ_{R'}(B) = ofReal(λ^{−n})·μ_R(η⁻¹(B)) for every Borel B ⊆ ℝ^P, where μ_R = θHⁿ⌞M (IMRep.measure).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → ∃ R' : IMRep (dilation x lam '' U) n, R'.Represents (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') ∧ ∀ s : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet s → R'.measure s = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) * R.measure (dilation x lam ⁻¹' s)
